Messages.Author: a-e
Messages.Body:
Can Redistribution target uncontrolled Blood Brothers of same circle?

I think the answer is no, but Redistribution doesn't specify that other
Blood Brothers would need to controlled.

Name: Redistribution

[LoB:C]
Cardtype: Action
Discipline: Sanguinus
+1 stealth action.
[san] This acting vampire gains a blood. Then move any amount of blood
and equipment among the Blood Brothers in this circle.
[SAN] As above, and untap this acting vampire.
Artist: Andrew Trabbold

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
a-e wrote:
> Can Redistribution target uncontrolled Blood Brothers of same circle?
>
> I think the answer is no, but Redistribution doesn't specify that other
> Blood Brothers would need to controlled.

The answer is no, because Redistribution doesn't specify that other Blood
Brothers could be uncontrolled.

Similarly, Giant's Blood cannot target an uncontrolled Blood Brother.

Messages.Author: Cry Wolf
Messages.Body:
IANLSJ, but I did some searching with the terms "uncontrolled effect
author:LSJ".

I found a discussion on a vampire receiving benefits from the Rack
whilst the vamp is in the uncontrolled region due to a Banishment.
Check out http://tinyurl.com/ylhddf

LSJ said that in the absence of _enabling_text_, something cannot be
assumed. By virtue of that, I'd say no. I think Redistribution is
understood to apply only to controlled (even torporized) vampires, even
vampires controlled by other Methuselahs (though Rehlow stated in
http://tinyurl.com/uunzb that if Blood Brothers of the same circle
(barring the Mexico circles) are present, then you're pretty much
screwed).

Hope to help, in a way.

Cry Wolf

This is even covered in the rulebook!

1.6.1.4 (of the online rulebook)
(http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/rulebook/)

Targets. If a card is played on another card, or selects or chooses or
otherwise targets another card, the target card must be in play (i.e.,
controlled). Vampires in the torpor region are eligible targets by
default, *but vampires in the uncontrolled region and contested cards
are not*.

Emphasis added.
